title.value: A model-free approach for solving choice-based competitive facility location problems using simulation and submodularity
title.justification: The title accurately reflects the main focus and methodology of the paper, which is to develop a model-free approach using simulation and submodularity to solve competitive facility location problems.
title.quote: Title of the paper: A model-free approach for solving choice-based competitive facility location problems using simulation and submodularity

extractions.description: This paper introduces a model-free approach for solving competitive facility location problems by reformulating the problem as a maximum covering location problem. It uses simulation to approximate preference profiles and submodular cuts to optimize the location of facilities to maximize market share. The approach does not rely on restrictive assumptions about customer utility functions, making it versatile for different customer behavior models. Computational experiments demonstrate that this method can outperform existing heuristics and exact methods, especially for large instances.
